Imports entity store directly and mutates it to duplicate widgets instead of using entity operations Fix: Remove import of useWidgetStore from @app/entities/widget/store and duplicate widgets only through entity layer functions (e.g. createWidget/duplicate operation); never import or write to store inner files from a screen or block

Imports entity store inner file and writes records with setState/crypto.randomUUID instead of entity operations Fix: Remove import from @app/entities/widget/store and replace direct useWidgetStore.setState and crypto.randomUUID duplication with entity create/duplicate functions; screens/blocks must only use hooks and async functions exported from @app/entities/<entity>

Uses mockCall('updatePassword') instead of entity layer auth operation to change password Fix: Replace mockCall with the auth entity's update/change-password function/hook and handle its success/error as the flow describes; do not call mock or fetch directly from component

Single page component loads records, holds all form/dialog state for every widget type, and lays out entire screen Fix: Split into single-purpose components (e.g. separate widget cards, dialogs, and edit controls in components/ beside route or in blocks) so page composes them instead of containing all logic

Import order violates shared->entities->components->blocks->screens (blocks imported before entities/components) Fix: Reorder imports to entities first, then components, then blocks; e.g. import from @app/entities/dashboard before @app/components/* and @app/blocks/*

Import order violates layer order and contains dead imports/logic (components before entities) Fix: Reorder to entities before components and remove unused direct store/mock usage; keep only entity hooks/functions
Contains unused import NextLink and dead code paths Fix: Remove unused imports (NextLink) and any unused props/branches; ensure every import and branch is used

In-place rename adds a labeled Input ("Dashboard name") with error prop; A15 requires in-place edit has no label and no help text, with only icon buttons beside the value. Fix: Render the inline edit as an unlabeled field (no label/help) with save/cancel IconButtons beside the value, showing validation inline without a label.

In-place edits for dashboard name, widget title, counter label and checklist item use labeled Inputs; A15 forbids label/help text for in-place edits. Fix: Remove labels/help from all in-place edits (dashboard name, widget title, counter label, checklist item) and keep only the value with save/cancel icon buttons.

Note/counter/checklist validations show toast instead of marking the field with the design's messages (Max 5000, Max 40, Text is required and max 120) and keeping typed value without saving. Fix: Mark the specific field as invalid with the exact messages from S05 alternatives, keep what was typed, and do not save.

Widgets list is rendered as a div of Card components, not a Table or CardList; A13 requires every list of records be a Table or CardList. Fix: Render widgets with CardList (layout grid/column as appropriate) so the list uses the required component.

Alternative 'This dashboard is no longer available.' when a dashboard was deleted in the meantime is not built, and empty-state does not hide the frame's Create dashboard action. Fix: Add the deleted-dashboard alternative (message + show home list) and hide the frame Create action while the list is empty as S04 requires.
Alternative 'This widget is gone.' when a widget was deleted in the meantime is not built. Fix: Detect missing widget and show 'This widget is gone.' while rendering the editor without it.

Password validation and incorrect-password/failure messages are shown as form-level error, not as field-marked errors with the exact wording, and success/failure handling does not match S06 alternatives. Fix: Mark the fields as invalid with 'Current password is required and new password must be 8 to 128 characters' / 'Current password is incorrect.' / 'Could not update password. Try again.' and clear passwords for security as specified.

Checklist and link lists use array index as React key while items can be added/removed. Fix: Use a stable id from the record for each item's key (e.g. item id) and never use index where items can be added, removed or reordered.

Save/change actions can be triggered twice while running and do not wait/disable. Fix: Make every create/update/delete handler async, await its operation, disable its button while pending, and ignore a second press until it settles, showing success/error.

Duplicate/create/rename/delete actions run without a pending guard so a second press runs again. Fix: Track pending per action, disable the triggering control with loading/disabledWithReason while awaiting, and handle success/error once.

Reordering does two separate repositionWidget writes; if the second fails the order is left inconsistent. Fix: Perform the reorder as a single atomic operation or rollback on failure and tell the user what did not happen so records stay consistent.

Link href from widget records is rendered without restricting to http/https/app URLs. Fix: Validate/filter href before rendering and only render Link when it starts with http://, https:// or an app route; otherwise render plain text.

Saving/Saved indicator uses setTimeout without cleanup so it can set state after unmount/navigation. Fix: Store timer ids in a ref/effect and clear them in the effect cleanup, and guard against showing a stale load after the user moved to another dashboard.
Password save does not disable while awaiting and does not prevent double submit. Fix: Await the update, disable Save while pending, and react to success/error once per press.

Widgets render in a single narrow column (flex-col-gap-4) and ignore FD06 size, leaving empty space on 1280px and not showing small/medium/large footprint. Fix: Render widgets in a grid (e.g. 12-col grid or CardList layout="grid") and map size to column span so small/medium/large have different visual footprints and fill the width.

Editing header shows four filled Buttons (Add widget, Duplicate, Delete, Done) with equal weight; view has no single primary action. Fix: Keep one primary (Done or Add widget) and make the others secondary/ghost or move Duplicate/Delete to a menu; Delete stays variant="danger" as the only danger primary.

Saving/Saved indicator sits in its own row below PageHeader, not beside the dashboard name it describes. Fix: Place the Saving/Saved text inline with the title in PageHeader (or immediately beside it) so the status sits beside what it describes per U12.

In editing mode the name is not editable until user clicks an extra "Edit dashboard name" button, adding a step and a dangling button row. Fix: When editing is on, show the dashboard name directly as an editable field with current value and save/cancel icon buttons, without the intermediate button.
